estilo-redaccion.title: Writing style
estilo-redaccion.hint: Tone, structure, words you use and avoid. Used by CVs and letters.

perfil-conductual.title: Behavioral profile
perfil-conductual.hint: How you work, strengths, personality tests. For preparing interviews.

criterios.title: Criteria
criterios.hint: Deal-breakers and preferences in free text. The fit assessment cites them as risks.

narrativa.title: Narrative
narrativa.hint: Your story, motivation and how you explain changes. For interviews.

folders.candidaturas: What you sent in each application (fills up on its own)
folders.estilo: Samples of how you write (letters, emails, posts): the agent takes your tone from them, never facts.

fileLabel.linkedin: Your LinkedIn export (the compressed file LinkedIn sends you, or your profile as PDF)

contextIntro: Guides your agent: the tone of your CVs and letters, a job's risks and interview prep. It never backs a fact: whatever a CV or letter says must be in your profile. Edit them above or ask your agent.
documentsIntro: Your source documents. Your agent can read them to create or expand your profile, always asking you before writing.
title: My profile
intro: Everything a CV, letter or answer says comes from here. Each block is saved separately and can be undone.
